# A09-S38: Radio interview

Correspondence extract. [████] marks redaction; […] marks omission.

Thanks!
And I've had the interview placed at around 14.15. So you should show up out here at DR City at 14.00. Just report to reception, say your name and that you're going to Culture, and we'll come fetch you 😊

[████] I've asked him to try placing The Synthetic Party on the political axis – and to point out where the party could have big problems in the political landscape (and the opposite). It should be quite interesting 😊
